subject: Skopus private offer acceptance & staged activation plan
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@skopus.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@skopus.ai>
Date: 2027-01-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private offer questions — acceptance window and activation sequencing

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We reviewed the private offer PDF internally and procurement asked for a couple clarifications before we can raise the PO:

- Can we stagger activation across regions? We want US production first (Mar 1 target), EU follow-on (Jun 1).
- How will pro-ration work if we uplift committed capacity in month 4?
- SOC2 evidence + data residency statements — your security team said they'd provide a short packet; can you share that so legal can close out?

I've attached our preliminary PO (Skopus_PO_v1.pdf) — we'll aim to convert to a formal PO after answers. We're aiming to sign by Feb 18 if possible.

Appreciate a short bullet list of the acceptance steps so I can forward to our procurement lead.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Infrastructure & Ops | Skopus AI
[attachment: Skopus_PO_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@skopus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-21T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private offer questions — acceptance window and activation sequencing

Elena — thanks for the note and the PO draft. Short answers up front, details below so you can share with procurement: 

1) Staged activation: yes — we can sequence activation by region. Typical plan: enable US tenant on day 1 (private offer accepted + marketplace activation), then enable EU tenant when the second invoice tranche is accepted. We'll include a staged activation clause in the private offer amendment.

2) Pro-ration for uplifts: we support mid-term capacity increases. If Skopus ups the committed units in month 4, billing will reflect the prorated uplift from the activation date; we can add an estimated pro-rate example to the SOW.

3) Security packet: attaching the acceptance checklist we use for Marketplace acceptances and a short SOC2 excerpt. Our security ops will also send the full evidence bundle under separate cover (redacted artifacts).

Next steps (recommended):
- Redline the AWS_Private_Offer_Draft.pdf (we'll accept edits that don't change marketplace billing mechanics).
- Procurement sends a signed PO (we can accept DocuSign).
- We generate the Private Offer in AWS Marketplace and send the offer link for acceptance.
- Upon acceptance, we kick the US activation, and schedule EU activation per the timeline you confirm.

I'm looping Ben for billing cadence and Marissa for execution timeline. If Feb 18 is your target, we should aim to finalize redlines by Feb 4 to allow legal/marketplace processing.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[attachment: Acceptance_Checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@skopus.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-25T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Skopus private offer — proposed billing tranches & timeline

Hi Elena — quick note on the billing sequencing we recommend so procurement can include it in the PO: 

- Tranche 1 (US activation): invoice upon AWS Marketplace acceptance, covers months 1–6 committed capacity.
- Tranche 2 (EU activation): invoice at EU activation (planned month 4 or month 6 depending on your ops readiness) and covers months 1–12 of EU committed capacity.
- Uplifts: any committed uplift mid-term will be invoiced pro-rated from the uplift activation date.

I've attached an updated private offer draft with a sample pro-rate table and a simplified acceptance checklist to paste into your PO. For DocuSign acceptance we recommend routing to Jamie O'Neill (legal) and procurement@skopus.ai.

If you want, Olga and I can run a 30-minute alignment call next week to walk procurement through the acceptance flow in the marketplace console — that often speeds acceptance.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: AWS_Private_Offer_Draft.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Elena Morales <elena@skopus.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@skopus.ai>, Jamie O'Neill <jamie.oneill@skopus.ai>
Date: 2027-02-02T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Skopus private offer — proposed billing tranches & timeline

Marissa / Olga,

Thanks — the draft looks good. Procurement has two quick redlines:

- They want explicit language that US activation must occur within 10 business days of the Marketplace offer acceptance link being clicked.
- They asked for a short example of how uplift proration would appear on the invoice (line item + effective date).

Jamie from legal asked whether Redwood can provide the SOC2 artifact bundle as a password-protected zip via secure link; that will unblock legal review.

We'll circulate a signed PO (via DocuSign) this week pending the SOC2 upload. Also confirming: we're planning to activate US on Mar 1, so please let us know any configuration steps we should complete beforehand.

Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Infrastructure & Ops | Skopus AI

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@skopus.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-12T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Final steps — Marketplace private offer creation & acceptance link

Elena — looping in the final ops items and timing from billing/legal side: 

1) We'll generate the AWS private offer once we receive the executed PO via DocuSign. Expect the private offer to appear in your AWS account within 48 hours from our submission (AWS processing times vary).
2) For the SOC2 bundle: we'll upload a password-protected archive to our secure artifacts bucket and email the link + one-time password to Jamie.
3) For the March 1 US activation: please confirm the primary AWS account email we should send the acceptance link to (ideally the account that will accept the offer).

Attached is the latest SOW (Skopus_SOW_v3.docx) with the staged activation language and a sample invoice line showing pro-rated uplifts. If we get the signed PO by Feb 18 we can meet the March 1 target.

Ben Carter
Senior Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
[attachment: Skopus_SOW_v3.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
